about: Caps, models and prices for AI exploration runs (explore.mjs; issue #302 slice D). A live run stops at whichever cap it reaches first, and a model with no price here is refused before it is called. Prices are dollars per million tokens; check them against Anthropic's price list before a run and correct them here when they change — the run's cost is computed from this table, not billed from it. notMemory: stores the observer finds a fact in and does not count as memory — diagnostic logs no narration is built from. ignoreWindows: windows on the player's screen the player is not shown — the game system's own first-start prompt. reviewer.enabled: off by default — a live run is reviewed by the agent that made it (rules/ci-e2e.md), which reads the prompts and records an API reviewer is never shown; turn it on for a run nobody will read.

prices.notes: Standard rates. A cache write is charged at 1.25 times input (lib/budget.mjs). Haiku 5.5 costs five times these rates on a prompt over 100,000 tokens; the module's prompts are a few thousand.
